correctness.rationale: For every N>=1, 0<delta1<...<deltaN and epsilon>0, the identity h_delta=xy(L-delta) gives H=(xy)^N P(L), with L=(x+1+x^{-1})(y+1+y^{-1})-9. Differentiating H and adding correction epsilon N H(x,-y) cancels exactly the extra J∇log(xy) term, yielding new field (xy)^N P(L)F0+epsilon(xy)^(N+1)P′(L)J∇L. The exact strict Lyapunov derivative Ldot=-(xy)^N P(L)D with D>0 off (1,1), and proper strictly convex log-coordinate sublevels, excludes additional cycles/equilibria and fixes all basins. Root signs P′(delta_i) yield hyperbolic alternating cycle stabilities; center Jacobian eigenvalues -2P(0)±6i epsilon P′(0) yield focus parity. Along each oval correction H times vector vanishes, preserving parametrized trajectory and minimal original-time period. The cofactor correction in the transverse H equation is total derivative d[N log(xy)]/dt, so the original and completed multipliers agree on each closed orbit. Speed gives the T_i integral; the divergence identity -div(F0/(xy))=(1+1/y)/x²+(1+1/x)/y²>0 yields multiplier A(delta)/epsilon by Green. Axis boundary terms are (1+y)(y²+y+1)^N and (1+x)(x²+x+1)^N, permitting mass-action production/consumption realization at degree 4N+2. Independent SymPy checked exact cancellation, Ldot and divergence for N=1,2,3 and analytically the product-rule identities hold all N; finite checks do not substitute for the all-N derivation.
